plates.statement: What could someone {action|collect} from {focus|an ordinary routine} that reveals {opening|what normally escapes their attention}?

focus.label: Everyday routines
questions: Which parts of a familiar day have become almost invisible?

action.label: Collect
questions: What might count as a fragment worth keeping?

opening.label: Overlooked details
questions: What might surprise someone about their own choices?

plates.statement: How might someone {action|interrupt} {focus|a familiar habit} to notice {opening|what they depend on without realising}?

focus.label: Familiar habits
questions: What is repeated without much conscious thought?

action.label: Interrupt
questions: How might a small change make the familiar strange?

opening.label: Hidden dependencies
questions: What becomes apparent only when something changes?

plates.statement: What small {action|ritual could someone repeat} to explore {focus|a changing everyday experience} and notice {opening|what stays unexpectedly consistent}?

focus.label: Changes in experience
questions: Which moments appear similar but feel different?

action.label: Repeat a ritual
questions: What might repetition allow someone to recognise?

opening.label: Unexpected constants
questions: What remains steady when circumstances change?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|mark} to distinguish {focus|being in a place} from {opening|feeling that they belong there}?

focus.label: Place and presence
questions: Where does physical location fail to tell the whole story?

action.label: Mark
questions: What might someone choose as a meaningful moment or position?

opening.label: Sense of belonging
questions: Could presence and attachment tell different stories?

plates.statement: How could someone {action|exchange something} to explore {focus|their everyday relationships} and reveal {opening|what they value in those exchanges}?

focus.label: Everyday relationships
questions: What is given, expected or reciprocated?

action.label: Exchange
questions: What might become significant through giving or receiving?

opening.label: Personal value
questions: What do these exchanges mean to different people?

plates.statement: What could someone {action|rearrange} about {focus|a familiar environment} to express {opening|where they feel most at home}?

focus.label: Familiar environments
questions: What makes a place personally meaningful?

action.label: Rearrange
questions: How might shifting relationships express a perspective?

opening.label: Personal territory
questions: What feels like home without being owned?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|preserve} from {focus|a fleeting experience} that later reveals {opening|what memory tends to leave behind}?

focus.label: Fleeting experiences
questions: Which moments are difficult to hold onto?

action.label: Preserve
questions: What might act as a reminder without explaining everything?

opening.label: The edges of memory
questions: What disappears when an experience becomes a recollection?

plates.statement: How could someone {action|represent twice} {focus|a remembered event} to expose {opening|the distance between experience and recollection}?

focus.label: Remembered events
questions: How stable are accounts of something that happened?

action.label: Represent twice
questions: What could change between two versions?

opening.label: Memory versus experience
questions: What is altered by the act of remembering?

plates.statement: What could someone {action|accumulate over time} to make {focus|a gradual change} visible in {opening|ways a single snapshot would miss}?

focus.label: Gradual change
questions: What unfolds too slowly to notice at once?

action.label: Accumulate
questions: How might many small contributions work together?

opening.label: Patterns over time
questions: What only becomes meaningful in a sequence?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|transform} to communicate {focus|a difficult-to-name feeling} and expose {opening|what words struggle to hold}?

focus.label: Difficult feelings
questions: Which experiences resist clear labels?

action.label: Transform
questions: How might a change carry personal meaning?

opening.label: Beyond words
questions: What can be expressed without being explained?

plates.statement: How could someone {action|pair unrelated things} to express {focus|a personal association} that reveals {opening|an unexpected way of seeing the familiar}?

focus.label: Personal associations
questions: What connections exist only for this participant?

action.label: Pair
questions: What could become meaningful through juxtaposition?

opening.label: Unexpected connections
questions: What does the pairing reveal without a correct interpretation?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|invent} to represent {focus|the atmosphere of a familiar situation} and disclose {opening|a perspective others do not share}?

focus.label: Atmosphere and feeling
questions: How does the same situation feel to different people?

action.label: Invent
questions: What might a participant create without a given vocabulary?

opening.label: Subjective perspectives
questions: What personal qualities become visible?

plates.statement: What could someone {action|leave deliberately incomplete} when representing {focus|an ordinary day}, and what might {opening|those gaps invite us to question}?

focus.label: The ordinary day
questions: Which parts of an account are assumed to be complete?

action.label: Leave incomplete
questions: How could omission be a meaningful choice?

opening.label: Meaningful gaps
questions: Does silence necessarily indicate absence?

plates.statement: How might someone {action|trace what they avoid} within {focus|a familiar situation} to reveal {opening|boundaries no one has explicitly drawn}?

focus.label: Avoidance
questions: Where does behaviour change without obvious explanation?

action.label: Trace avoidance
questions: How might absence or detour become expressive?

opening.label: Invisible boundaries
questions: What conventions or concerns remain unspoken?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|arrange in contrast} to explore {focus|their intentions and actual actions} and uncover {opening|contradictions they find meaningful}?

focus.label: Intention and action
questions: Where does what people plan diverge from what they do?

action.label: Arrange in contrast
questions: How could difference become tangible?

opening.label: Lived contradictions
questions: Must every inconsistency be resolved?

plates.statement: How might someone {action|give form to} {focus|a key idea beneath your concept} and reveal {opening|a meaning different from the one you assumed}?

focus.label: The central idea
questions: Which concept does your proposal take for granted?

action.label: Give form
questions: What could someone make or express without being shown your solution?

opening.label: Alternative meanings
questions: What if their definition is unlike yours?

plates.statement: What could someone {action|rearrange} to explore {focus|relationships your idea relies on} and expose {opening|connections you have overlooked}?

focus.label: Assumed relationships
questions: Which elements have you already connected in your mind?

action.label: Rearrange
questions: How might a participant establish their own connections?

opening.label: Unanticipated connections
questions: Which relationships might differ from your model?

plates.statement: How might someone {action|invent their own representation} of {focus|a concept you have already defined} to suggest {opening|a different interpretation}?

focus.label: Established definitions
questions: Where has your design already assigned meaning?

action.label: Invent a representation
questions: How much space can participants have to redefine it?

opening.label: Different interpretations
questions: Could an alternative meaning still be valid?

plates.statement: What could someone {action|anticipate through a small activity} about {focus|a situation your idea addresses} that reveals {opening|expectations your concept may not meet}?

focus.label: Situated expectations
questions: What do people imagine will happen next?

action.label: Anticipate
questions: How might expectation become an expressive act?

opening.label: Mismatched expectations
questions: Which expectations might your idea unintentionally contradict?

plates.statement: How might someone {action|reconstruct a sequence} around {focus|an anticipated encounter} and show {opening|where their expectations diverge from yours}?

focus.label: Anticipated encounters
questions: What order seems natural to a participant?

action.label: Reconstruct
questions: What could someone put into their own sequence?

opening.label: Different sequences
questions: What does a different order imply for the design?

plates.statement: What could someone {action|alter} about {focus|an imagined outcome} to communicate {opening|what they expected instead}?

focus.label: Imagined outcomes
questions: What conclusion does your proposal presume people want?

action.label: Alter
questions: How could a participant rework a possibility?

opening.label: Unmet expectations
questions: What alternative outcome matters to them?

plates.statement: How might someone {action|rearrange} {focus|competing priorities} to reveal {opening|what they are unwilling to compromise}?

focus.label: Competing priorities
questions: Which needs compete in your proposed situation?

action.label: Rearrange
questions: What could someone move, order or change in relation to other things?

opening.label: Non-negotiable values
questions: What matters even when the situation changes?

plates.statement: What could someone {action|exchange or surrender} to explore {focus|what they value in a decision} and reveal {opening|what they refuse to trade away}?

focus.label: Decision values
questions: What matters when the choice has a cost?

action.label: Exchange or surrender
questions: What might giving something up make tangible?

opening.label: Limits of compromise
questions: What would someone protect despite the trade-off?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|choose to preserve} when {focus|their options are restricted}, revealing {opening|priorities your idea has not considered}?

focus.label: Constrained choices
questions: How do conditions affect what feels possible?

action.label: Choose to preserve
questions: How might selection express value?

opening.label: Unexpected priorities
questions: What might they protect that your proposal overlooks?

plates.statement: How could someone {action|connect and order} {focus|parts of an interaction} to demonstrate {opening|a logic different from your proposed sequence}?

focus.label: Interaction relationships
questions: How are the parts of your concept connected?

action.label: Connect and order
questions: Could participants establish a sequence themselves?

opening.label: Alternative logics
questions: What if their sequence is coherent but unfamiliar?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|physically rearrange} to express {focus|how an experience should unfold} and reveal {opening|an assumption built into your concept}?

focus.label: Experience sequence
questions: Where have you decided the order of events?

action.label: Physically rearrange
questions: What does manipulating a sequence make possible?

opening.label: Built-in assumptions
questions: Which steps might a participant combine, omit or reverse?

plates.statement: How could someone {action|represent an overlooked connection} within {focus|the situation behind your concept} and expose {opening|a relationship the proposal does not yet address}?

focus.label: Context of the idea
questions: Who or what may be absent from your current model?

action.label: Represent a connection
questions: How might relationships become tangible?

opening.label: Missing relationships
questions: What new obligation or tension might this connection introduce?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|change about a familiar situation} to challenge {focus|an assumption supporting your idea} and explore {opening|when that assumption no longer holds}?

focus.label: Conceptual assumptions
questions: What must be true for your idea to make sense?

action.label: Change a situation
questions: What small alteration might expose a dependency?

opening.label: Limits of the premise
questions: Under what conditions might your concept break down?

plates.statement: What might someone {action|refuse or reinterpret} within {focus|the situation your idea proposes} to reveal {opening|where their experience resists your model}?

focus.label: The proposed situation
questions: Which forms of participation have you presumed?

action.label: Refuse or reinterpret
questions: Can declining or adapting the invitation be meaningful?

opening.label: Resistance to the model
questions: What does a refusal make you reconsider?

plates.statement: How might someone {action|construct an alternative} to {focus|the situation your concept addresses} and uncover {opening|a possibility you did not think to offer}?

focus.label: The problem framing
questions: What version of the situation have you assumed?

action.label: Construct an alternative
questions: How might participants imagine something else?

opening.label: Unanticipated possibilities
questions: What if their alternative changes the problem itself?
